claims.scope: Aurightec Estonia AS, FY2025 vs FY2024
claims.statement: Revenue €36,466,707 versus €40,785,234, a reported decline of €4,318,527 (10.59%).
claims.limit: Subsidiary accounts; not group turnover or organic sales.

claims.scope: Aurightec Estonia AS, related-party sales, FY2025 vs FY2024
claims.statement: Sales to other companies in the consolidation group fell from €4,152,422 (€4,070,673 goods and €81,749 services) to €207,469 (goods only). The note states these are included in revenue.
claims.locator: note 18, PDF pp. 22-23, MÜÜDUD and explanatory paragraph
claims.limit: Classification and counterparty changes after disposals require reconciliation.

claims.scope: Aurightec Estonia AS, arithmetic decomposition only
claims.statement: The €3,944,953 decline in disclosed related-party sales is 91.35% of the €4,318,527 reported revenue decline. Subtracting disclosed related-party sales yields €36,259,238 in 2025 versus €36,632,812 in 2024, a 1.02% decline.
claims.limit: Not an organic growth estimate, causal attribution, or proof that external customer demand was stable. Do not add the separate geographic Morocco delta to related-party delta.

claims.statement: Net loss €902,739, raw materials and materials expense €22,792,125, inventories €5,775,028; this raw-materials line is 62.50% of revenue. The wider goods/raw materials/services category totals €23,643,169.
claims.locator: financial statements and notes, PDF pp. 6-8, 20-21, note 14
claims.limit: Expense share is not avoidable savings or a procurement ROI.

claims.statement: Consolidated accounts for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 were filed.
claims.limit: Notice contains no financial amounts. The original consolidated accounts remain unread.

claims.statement: Listed by JIPM among 2024 Award for TPM Excellence recipients.
claims.locator: Winners for 2024 Awards, Award for TPM Excellence, Eolane (China) entry
claims.limit: Does not validate Aurightec's claimed 23% defect or 50% downtime reductions, nor establish AI causality.

claims.statement: Aurightec China states that it launched a local AI platform in H1 2025, connected an early-2025 data warehouse to enterprise systems, and deployed OCR, order handling, AIOps, knowledge and 8D assistance.
claims.limit: One corporate editorial origin; deployment and measured impact unverified independently, group replication unknown.
